description:
A High Voltage DC transmission line for modeling DC transmission networks.

This line must be connected to a `DCBus` on each end. It uses a T-Model of the line impedance. This is suitable for operational simulations with a multi-terminal DC network.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `PowerLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `PowerLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`). Unavailable components are excluded during simulations.

active_power_flow.description: Initial condition of active power flow on the line. Units: MW.

arc.description: An `Arc` defining this line `from` a bus `to` another bus.

parameter_units.description: Unit basis for this line's impedance field (r).

base_current.description: Base current for per-unitization of this line's per-unit fields — this DC line per-unitizes against a current base, not a power base. Units: A.

r.description: Total series resistance, split equally on both sides of the shunt capacitance. Units: per parameter_units — NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

l.description: Total series inductance, split equally on both sides of the shunt capacitance. Per-unit on this line's `base_current`. Units: pu.

c.description: Shunt capacitance. Per-unit on this line's `base_current`. Units: pu.

active_power_limits_from.description: Minimum and maximum active power flows to the FROM node. Units: MW.

active_power_limits_to.description: Minimum and maximum active power flows to the TO node. Units: MW.

title: TModelHVDCLine
